verdict.rationale: GlitchTip's evidence covers issue tracking, alerts, teams, and Sentry-compatible SDKs, but there is no mention of cross-project/team trend dashboards, top regressions, new-issues-per-release views, or volume-over-time charts; in fact the vendor explicitly states 'No dashboard building and metrics hunting' for its performance view, signaling this is not a built capability. missing for 10: any dashboard or trend visualization feature, per-release issue breakdown, regression tracking, cross-team/project rollups.
